attempted_claim: Let X_CS: S^1 × S^1 × S^1 ↪ S^4 be the embedded minimal hypertorus constructed by Carlotto and Schulz, and let J = −Δ − |A|^2 − 3 be its stability operator. Determine the exact Morse index ind(X_CS), counted with multiplicity; in particular, prove or disprove the conjecture ind(X_CS) = 27.
decisive_failure: No closed-form CS profile, metric, or |A|^2 was available in-lane, so no certified two-sided Jacobi spectral enclosure could be built; the flat-torus lattice count is an elementary heuristic with no force on the true geometry; Perdomo part II numerics for index 27 were surveyed but neither reproduced nor certified here.
